appearance: Black coated metal, restrained wear, fine grain, distinct polymer and rubber.
barrel_replacement: Select one Barrel combo; its Foregrip, Muzzle and FrontIron sockets move dependent attachments.
verification_limits: External reference reconstruction, not an original game mesh. Opposite-side detail and exact game scale remain inferred.
unreal_import_status: not imported or tested in Unreal Editor
export_origin: Individual assets: authored local mount; presets: selected barrel resolves dependent attachment origins.
export_uv_policy: Preserved evaluated source UVs; unwrap only individual copies lacking UVs.
fbx_axis_note: +X forward / +Z up; use_space_transform=True; metres with unit scaling enabled.
textures: Independent baked BaseColor / Normal / ORM PNGs in Textures/Baked; embedded in GLB and FBX COPY exports.
refinements: Thin-wall through apertures in both handguards; real deep receiver channel and opposite-side pocket; raised receiver guide relief; matte curved grip interior; continuous rounded pressed magazine surfaces and rolled floorplate seams. Curved outer skins, integrated pressed recesses, sloping shell shoulders and geometric cross-section changes; fine grain reduced to preserve readable volume.

high_detail_review.method: Fresh samples of curved skins, triangulated small surface cells, smooth normal transitions, 6–8 segment edge bevels.

baseline.status: Historical geometry and pre-material input; never edited by the material generator.

material_stage: Portable baked BaseColor, Normal and ORM atlases; editable layer graphs retained
normal_map_convention: OpenGL tangent +Y; DirectX import workflows must invert the green channel.

front_refinement.localized_region: Front positive-Z shoulder only; X >= .570 m

style_interpretation: Restrained industrial black/gray, clearly separated coated metal, bare hardware, polymer and rubber; local wear for readability, no broad grime or mirror finish, no project codename markings.

lighting_recipe.comparison: The same recipe is applied when rendering the historical baseline.
